soil.title: AI Soil Testing
soil.tipText: Current soil condition is highly suitable for crops in Kothavalasa and Mangalapalem regions.
soil.cropLegumes: Groundnut, Green Gram, Black Gram, Cowpea
soil.fertNitrogenDeficient: Apply organic manure, neem cake, and vermicompost to boost nitrogen content.
soil.fertPhosphorusDeficient: Add bone meal, rock phosphate, or mycorrhiza to enhance phosphorus levels.
soil.fertPotassiumDeficient: Incorporate wood ash, bio-potash, or seaweed extract to restore potassium.
soil.fertExcessive: Reduce manure application, plant cover crops (like rye or mustard) to absorb excess nutrients.
soil.fertBalanced: Apply light vermicompost or compost tea to maintain soil fertility.
soil.irrigateAcidic: Acidic soil: regular watering, apply agricultural lime (calcium carbonate), avoid waterlogging.
soil.irrigateAlkaline: Alkaline soil: frequent light irrigation, add gypsum, use organic mulching.
soil.irrigateModerate: Moderate irrigation recommended based on crop cycle.
soil.tipNitrogenDef: Nitrogen is low. Growing legume crops like groundnut naturally fixes nitrogen into your soil.
soil.tipPhosphorusDef: Phosphorus is low. Mix phosphate-solubilizing bacteria (PSB) with compost to unlock bound phosphorus.
soil.tipPotassiumDef: Potassium is low. Wood ash is an excellent, low-cost organic source of potash.
soil.tipBalanced: Your soil has an excellent nutrient balance! Practice crop rotation to sustain it.
soil.tipExcessive: High nutrient levels detected. Avoid over-composting and ensure good drainage to prevent runoff.
